title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i-th` day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. Return the maximum profit you can achieve.

hints.content: Keep track of the minimum price observed so far as you iterate.
At each day, the potential profit is prices[i] - minPrice.
Maintain minPrice and maxProfit in a single pass through the array.

solution.explanation:
Track the minimum purchase price seen so far and compare the current profit with the maximum profit seen so far.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1)
